notes: Fastned vehicle page chart data (the page embeds a per-percent kW series); Fastned says the curve shows the car on its network with the battery in optimal conditions (around 30 °C), and a colder or warmer battery can charge much slower. Sampled every 5 % plus the first, last and peak points. Fastned does not state the session count, ambient temperature or preconditioning. Fastned page for the 64 kWh e-Niro 2018-2022, the same series as Fastned shows for the 64 kWh Kona. Applied to US/Canada 2019-2022 Niro EV (same 64 kWh pack, 77 kW). Second source: InsideEVs 2019 Niro EV test saw 25 kW by 80 %.
